item.title: Supplier Spotlight: Hummingbird Travel
item.description:
Supplier Spotlight: Hummingbird Travel
Hummingbird Travel is a trade-only luxury DMC, family-run since 1988 and the largest luxury operator in the Maldives. The JLT webinar covered where it fits for premium and honeymoon bookings.
Coverage: Maldives (155+ resort contracts), Mauritius, Seychelles, Sri Lanka, 20+ Caribbean islands and Mexico.
Model: Own ground-handling staff in every destination, rather than a bed-bank arrangement, with 24/7 support and VIP airport handling.
Portal: Live rates and instant confirmation, with the base transfer included in the quoted price.
Fit: Luxury tour operators, boutique agencies and concierge companies. Honeymoons, celebrations, multi-generational and twin-centre itineraries. Not suited to budget or highly price-sensitive bookings.
Off-season Maldives can save clients up to around 75% versus a high-end European summer.
Full spotlight on the Agent Hub.

item.title: Royal Caribbean International has brought Legend of the Seas into service: the third Icon-class ship, and the first of the class to sail in Europe.
item.description:
Royal Caribbean International has brought Legend of the Seas into service: the third Icon-class ship, and the first of the class to sail in Europe.
For agents, the appeal is breadth. One booking covers several completely different holidays, which suits multigenerational family groups and first-time cruisers in particular.
Key facts:
Coverage: Western Mediterranean from Barcelona and Rome now; Caribbean via Fort Lauderdale from autumn; Europe again in summer 2027. Scale: 5,610 guests at double occupancy, 28 restaurants, eight neighbourhoods. Trade support: Club Royal portal, Royal Genie digital brochures, Upper Deck rewards.
Less suited to clients seeking a small-ship or classic-liner experience.
Full spotlight on the JLT Agent Hub.
